method.freeze: present gap over 150 ms between new frames
method.lane: hw: clip 1080p60, 8000 kbps at 60 fps, preset ultra, hardware encode and decode
method.path: reference clip (MELLO_CAPTURE_REFERENCE) -> D3D11 video processor -> preprocessor -> encoder -> mello-core manager and SfuSink -> RTP sender -> shim (UDP proxy, host leg) -> mello-sfu in test mode -> shim (viewer leg) -> RTP receiver session -> receive timeline (stage 3) -> viewer decode thread -> present thread at each render time -> CPU frame callback
method.shim: netmodel shim version 1; base delay 10 ms each way per leg
method.vmaf: vmaf_v0.6.1 on luma, every 1 new frame(s)

bad.description: Viewer on a bad link: 5 % random loss plus Gilbert-Elliott bursts (about 5 % more), 10 % in total, 30 ms jitter.

clean.description: 10 ms each way on both legs, nothing else.

congested.description: Host uplink capped at 60 % of the lane preset with a 150 ms tail-drop queue from 5 s for 20 s, then released.

home-wifi.description: Viewer on Wi-Fi: 2 % random loss, 20 ms jitter on the SFU to viewer leg.

late-join.description: A second viewer joins at 5 s on clean legs. Measured on that viewer; the first viewer's freeze time is other_viewer_freeze_ms.

mobile.description: Viewer on a mobile link: 5 % loss, 40 ms jitter, 250 ms delay spikes about 6 per minute, light reorder, 300 ppm clock drift.

outage.description: Host leg down in both directions for 3 s from 8 s.

scorer.psnr_ssim: stream-gate score.rs: luma, PSNR 10 log10(255^2/MSE) capped at 100, SSIM 8x8 windows on a 4 px grid
